Port Coquitlam real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
Port Coquitlam houses by price band, September 2026

26 houses sold in September against 153 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 11 sold (42% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 at 23%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Port Coquitlam houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Port Coquitlam peaked at 172 in June 2026 and bottomed at 99 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in April 2026 with 26. The reported sale price moved from $1,350,000 to $1,262,500, a change of −6.5%.
